Method of Attack: Leaking Windows domain credentials in plain text by misconfigured email clients using Basic Auth
Attack Vector: Basic Authentication (Basic Auth) in Microsoft Exchange Online
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Basic Auth protocols: MAPI, RPC, Offline Address Book (OAB), Exchange Web Services (EWS), POP, IMAP, Remote PowerShell
Disabled SMTP AUTH in millions of tenants not using it
